content.value: “X" hospital is developing a new online appointment system. The IT department has fixed (12) [CO3] set of requirements. Hospital administrators demand a quick interface mock-up for early visualization before final development. Now, answer the followings:
i) Identify the most suitable SDLC model for the IT team and administrators.
ii) As a developer, which model would you prefer and why?
